profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley's vLLM team develops an open-source, high-throughput inference engine for large language models. The project is self-hosted with no external data sharing, positioning it as an alternative to proprietary inference services.

vLLM is the team's primary product offering, designed to optimize the serving and inference of large language models. As a university-lab initiative, the work reflects Berkeley's broader engagement in open-source AI infrastructure development.
